about.title: We strive to build a human-centered organization and safety system.
about.para1: Korea, surrounded by sea on three sides, has been nurturing maritime personnel seeking to enter the shipping industry.
about.para2: However, with continuous economic growth and rising national income, Korea's shipping industry has weakened in competitiveness and faces a shortage of crew members. Even excellent marine engineers are leaving the maritime industry.
about.para3: SUNGAN SHIPPING has established a foundation where Korean shipping managers can feel rewarded in their careers despite the challenging working conditions.
about.para4: The definition of 'ship management business' is to take on the responsibility and risk of ship repair, routing, safe operation, insurance, and crew management through consignment requests from shipowners. Therefore, the foundation is the shipowner's trust and expertise in ships.
about.para5: SUNGAN SHIPPING Co., Ltd. has accumulated expertise particularly in bulk carriers, RO-RO ships, and passenger ships. The company has received high praise and trust from shipowners, and employees take pride in managing specialized ships.
about.para6: Reflecting on the past and planning for the future is the ultimate goal of a company.
about.banner_text1: SUNGAN SHIPPING Co., Ltd. systematically improves its business in accordance with ISM CODE as part of its safety and environmental protection policies, and strives to build a human-centered organization and safety system for the future.
about.banner_text2: The company will provide safe operations and working environment to shipowners and customers.
about.area_of_focus_subtitle: The company will provide safe operations and working environment to shipowners and customers.
about.focus1: Through efficient quality management, we ensure safe operations and prevention of marine pollution for our customers, as well as provide management and maintenance of ships and assets.
about.focus2: By leveraging the advantages of a mixed team of skilled Korean and Myanmar crew members, we support our customers in achieving optimal operational performance and cost efficiency.
about.focus3: To maintain the best safe operation of ships, we implement re-embarkation policies and strengthen crew training.
about.focus4: We provide experienced crew members with excellent technical skills tailored to our customers' needs.
about.busan_desc: Crew operations, marine technology, safety management
about.yangon_desc: Myanmar crew management, training course development and material production

services.cert1_desc: Certification proving that the company is entrusted with establishing and implementing the safety management system for shipowners.
services.cert2_desc: Certification proving that the shipping company's safety management system complies with the requirements of the International Management Code for the Safe Operation of Ships and Pollution Prevention.
services.cert3_desc: This certificate proves that there are no violations related to ship security activities and prevents disadvantages such as denial of port entry or suspension of departure.
services.cert4_desc: Additional safety certification that ensures comprehensive compliance with international maritime safety standards and environmental protection regulations.
